title: The integral derived direct image of a constructible complex along a finite-type morphism is constructible
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be finite-type $K_0$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a $K_0$-morphism (of finite type; separatedness is not assumed) [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ be an object of the derived-complete integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$, the derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $Rf_{*,n}:D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ and
$$
 Rf_*K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}K_n\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)
$$
be the finite-level and the integral derived direct images of [def-weil-derived-direct-image], the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] being taken of the inverse system with the transition maps specified there. Then $Rf_*K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$. More precisely: $Rf_*K$ is derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete]; for every $n\geq1$ the finite-reduction comparison $(Rf_*K)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\to Rf_{*,n}K_n$ of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] is an isomorphism; $Rf_{*,n}K_n\in D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]; and if the cohomological supports [def-weil-cohomological-support] of all $K_n$ lie in $[a,b]$, then those of all $Rf_{*,n}K_n$ lie in $[a,b+N]$, where $N$ is an integer (independent of $n$) such that $R^qf_*M=0$ for $q>N$ and every sheaf $M$ of $A_{E,1}$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ (one may take $N=2\dim X$ when $K_0$ is algebraically closed).

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2 (Pushforward), p. 55, with its proof: completeness of $f_*K$ by Lemma 6.5.9 (2), p. 50; $f_*K\otimes_{\widehat R}R/\mathfrak m\simeq f_*(K\otimes_{\widehat R}R/\mathfrak m)$ by Lemma 6.5.11 (1),(3), p. 51 (under a cohomological-dimension bound $d$ for $f_*$ on $R/\mathfrak m$-modules, giving the amplitude $\leq k+m+d+2$ of 6.5.11 (1)); constructibility from Lemma 5.4.3, p. 39, and Theorem 6.7.1 (Grothendieck, Gabber: finite cohomological dimension and preservation of constructibility for $f$ finitely presented with $Y$ quasi-excellent and $\ell$-coprime), p. 55. Bhatt-Scholze's $D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat R)$ (Definition 6.5.1, p. 49) asks the reduction to be constructible with perfect values; the category here asks the reductions to be bounded constructible with finite stalks and a uniform amplitude, so the statement is the analogue of Lemma 6.7.2 for this category, with $R=\mathcal O_E$, $\mathfrak m=(\varpi_E)$
